name: Objective-Driven Execution
description: Ability to execute red team operations end-to-end, from initial access through to objective completion. Covers attack path selection, lateral movement, privilege escalation, persistence, and objective actions (data exfiltration, business process compromise) while maintaining operational coherence and staying within rules of engagement.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to red team operational execution

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the phases of a red team kill chain and key operational concepts
evidence: Completed red team operations training covering the full kill chain
Can describe initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and objective actions
Understands the difference between vulnerability exploitation and objective-driven operations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Executes assigned tasks within a red team campaign under direct guidance
evidence: Performed specific attack phases (e.g., lateral movement, data staging) as directed by team lead
Completed red team lab exercises covering full kill chains
Maintained operational logs and evidence collection under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently executes red team operations from initial access to objective completion
evidence: Executed 3+ red team campaigns achieving defined objectives independently
Demonstrated ability to pivot and adapt attack paths when blocked
Maintained clean operational logs and evidence trail throughout campaigns
Operated within rules of engagement without violations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads complex operations against hardened targets; adapts in real-time to active defence
evidence: Led operations against targets with active threat hunting and incident response
Achieved objectives in environments with segmented networks and advanced controls
Coordinated multi-operator campaigns with clear task delegation
Mentors operators on operational decision-making and adaptability

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Executes the most complex campaigns; develops operational methodology; recognised authority
evidence: Led CBEST, TIBER-EU, or equivalent regulatory red team campaigns to completion
Developed novel attack paths or operational techniques adopted by the lab
Defines lab operational playbooks and execution standards
Trains and certifies operators on red team execution

assessment_methods.description: Full red team exercise in lab environment: given objectives and rules of engagement, execute a campaign from initial access through objective completion
Shadow the operator during a live engagement, assessing decision-making, adaptability, and adherence to rules of engagement
